hypotheses.persona: Hybrid Office Worker (WFH Wed, Commute Thu)
hypotheses.rationale: Day 9 (Wed) showed no commute but desk presence; Day 10 (Thu) shows clear commute markers (keys at entry, laptop at desk) and standard evening routine. This fits a 2-3 day WFH pattern.
Day 9 was an anomaly (WFH or missed observation). Day 10 confirms standard commute. Requires Day 9 to be explained as a one-off or error.
Contradicted by the strong, specific 'keys at entry' signal on Day 10, which implies leaving the home for a fixed duration, unlike typical remote work fluidity.
